answer_result.answer: Dave regularly visits parks to relax and recharge, because he finds them peaceful and calming, especially when surrounded by nature.

evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- Calvin is looking forward to trying the food in Boston with Dave and called it fun ("Can't wait to try out the food there with you") [S3T17].
- As of 2023-05-31, the Boston visit is part of the Frank Ocean tour: "Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank!" — he's "buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like" and "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (calling Boston's folks "from home" suggests it is where he's from, though not stated outright). He asked Dave what he thinks of the music scene there; Dave: it's "awesome — Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play," and he'll be there to cheer Calvin on (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S7T15][S7T16].
- On 2023-06-09, said he has never been to Boston before but has heard the parks are amazing — "can't wait to visit next month" (i.e., July 2023); he wants to take walks in the Boston parks to experience their serenity and recharge, and asked Dave what cool things he remembers about them; shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers (likely from the album session); Dave's recollections of the Boston parks are in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston [S8T5][S8T7].
- As of 2023-08-22, said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, and proposed meeting up with Dave then — "Maybe we can meet up then!" (renewing the earlier plan to meet in Boston, see above); Dave: "Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Note: the 2023-08-14 update described the Frank Ocean tour as already having ended with the Tokyo show, so this "tour ends soon" may be a continuation or a new tour — unconfirmed) [S15T10][S15T11].
- On 2023-09-02, told Dave he booked a flight to Boston "last week" (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming Boston trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it — "See you soon, buddy!"; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (continuing the plan to meet up in Boston, see above) [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!"; Calvin thanked Dave, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].

- On 2023-05-31, reconnected with Dave ("been ages since we chatted") and told him the Frank Ocean tour the week before was "wild", including the "unreal" Tokyo show (details in ## Tokyo trip); Dave congratulated him [S7T1][S7T2]. Calvin thought Dave's car photo was of the car Dave had been fixing the engine of for a friend (Dave's neighbor; details in /memories/dave.md, section "Car maintenance shop"). The two also talked about how working on cars is relaxing: for Calvin it "chill[s]" him, "clears [his] head", "calms [him] down", and gives a real sense of achievement — "like meditating" — and Dave said the same applies to him (details in /memories/dave.md, section "Hobbies and sense of purpose") [S7T3][S7T4][S7T5][S7T6].
- The 2023-05-31 conversation continued: Calvin echoed Dave's "feeling of power and happiness" from the transformation talk — "It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas" [S7T9]. Dave asked whether he always enjoys performing live (see ## Music), then what's next for his music; Calvin named the Boston stop on the Frank Ocean tour — "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (see the Boston trip section above) [S7T10][S7T11][S7T14][S7T15]. Dave said he'll be at the Boston show to cheer him on [S7T16]. The 2023-05-31 conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to [him]" — and saying he can't wait to experience the Boston music scene; Dave wished him a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when he gets back, and Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details, signing off "See you soon!" [S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].
- On 2023-06-09, caught up with Dave: told him about the creative-team album session (details in ## Music) and that he's "stoked" about the album; Dave shared a photo of a pond with a boat in it surrounded by trees, and Calvin shared a photo of the studio (details in ## Music) and one of a tree with pink flowers (details in ## Boston trip) [S8T1][S8T2][S8T3][S8T5]. They talked about nature: Dave has been exploring parks on weekends to relax; Calvin, having never been to Boston, is "can't wait" to visit in July 2023 and asked about the Boston parks (details in ## Boston trip); when Calvin asked if Dave has been on any hikes recently, Dave said no but thinks hiking is awesome — "being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights"; details on Dave's park habit and his Boston-parks stroll are in /memories/dave.md > ## Parks [S8T4][S8T5][S8T6][S8T7][S8T8]. Then Dave announced he had booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023), and Calvin said he wants to go on a hike in the mountains to de-stress himself (details in ## Mountains and hiking); the two wished each other well for the trip and signed off "see you soon" (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Mountain trip (July 2023)) [S8T9][S8T10][S8T11][S8T12][S8T13][S8T14].
- On 2023-06-21, told Dave about the car accident and repair process (details in ## Car accident (2023-06-16)); Dave expressed sympathy that no one was hurt, asked about issues with the insurance process and how long it took, and asked about the mechanic in the garage photo [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].
- The 2023-06-21 conversation continued: Calvin answered Dave's skiing question — never tried it, but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might try it once (details in ## Mountains and hiking) [S9T17]. Dave then announced that he recently joined a rock band and has been practicing guitar, sharing a photo of the band; Calvin said it's awesome and will bring him a lot of emotions, and Dave said good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions (details in the Rock band section of /memories/dave.md). The conversation closed with Dave saying he had to go and "I'll see you soon!", and Calvin thanking Dave and saying "let's keep in touch, take care!" [S9T18][S9T19][S9T20][S9T21].

- As of 2023-03-23, has been spending lots of time lately at a beautiful park (lake with a few boats in photo) that he finds "so calming" [S1T16].
- Recommended the park to Calvin, who has never been there but called it "a chill spot" and plans to check it out when he's back [S1T16][S1T17].
- As of 2023-06-09, has been exploring parks on the weekends to relax — "it's so peaceful being surrounded by nature" [S8T4].
- As of 2023-06-09, loves taking walks on the weekends — "they recharge me for the entire upcoming week" [S8T6].
- On 2023-06-09, shared a photo of a pond with a boat in it surrounded by trees (likely the park he's been exploring) [S8T2].
- As of 2023-06-09, hasn't gone hiking recently but thinks it's awesome — "being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights"; it "clears your mind and brings a sense of calm"; he thinks the mountains are "super chill" [S8T8].
- As of 2023-07-07, has arranged regular walks together with friends at a favorite park spot — he shared a photo of it: a city skyline with a river and boats in the water; they were heading there that day ("Yeah, today we are going to that spot"). He finds the peace by the river really nice [S10T3][S10T5][S10T7].
- As of 2023-11-17, found a serene spot in a nearby park (rocks and a waterfall) and photographed the waterfall there the previous week (~2023-11-10/16), sharing the pic with Calvin — Calvin: "Can't wait to check it out myself sometime" (details of the exchange in the 2023-11-17 entry of ## Photography and /memories/calvin.md) [S30T13][S30T15].

- On 2023-11-17, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Calvin, long time no talk! A lot has happened.") and said he's taken up photography and it's been great — he's been taking pics of the scenery around his area, which is really cool (continuation of the 2023-10-29 thread, see below) [S30T1].
- On 2023-11-17, shared a photo of a boat floating in the water at sunset (a scenery shot from his new photography hobby) [S30T3]; and, after Calvin told him about his inspiring conversation with an artist at his Boston gala (Calvin's side in the Boston trip and Music sections of /memories/calvin.md), shared his new vintage camera that he bought this month (November 2023) (a photo of a camera sitting on a table next to a plant) — "which takes awesome photos!" — Calvin: "Do you use this camera for photos? They always turn out so good!"; Dave: yes — "this camera is very good, it helps me capture those special moments really clearly" [S30T5][S30T6][S30T7]; Calvin: "Having a good camera is key for capturing those special moments." and asked what Dave likes to take photos of (Calvin's message closed with a photo of a sunset with a wave crashing on rocks); Dave answered in a later message of the same chat (next bullet) [S30T8][S30T9].
- On 2023-11-17, answering Calvin's question about what he likes to take photos of: being able to take good pics is key, and he loves capturing the beauty of nature — sunsets, beaches, waves — sharing one he got recently (a photo of a sunset with a wave crashing on rocks); Calvin: "Nice job, Dave! That shot looks great! Nature's so amazing!" [S30T9][S30T10]. Dave added it's incredible how much emotion and beauty nature can convey through a photo, and agreed with Calvin that nature can boost the spirits in tough times [S30T11][S30T13]; he also shared a picture he snapped the previous week (~2023-11-10/16) — a peaceful scene of a waterfall flowing over rocks and boulders — taken at a serene spot in a nearby park (Calvin: "Wow Dave, that picture is stunning! Where was that taken? It looks so serene!"; the park details in ## Parks) [S30T13][S30T14][S30T15].
- On 2023-11-17, after Calvin closed the nature-photo exchange with a photo he shot in a Japanese garden (a bench under a tree with pink flowers), Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Found an even better spot, with a bench under a tree with pink flowers - so peaceful. A perfect spot to relax and take in the beauty." — describing the same bench-under-a-pink-flower-tree scene as "a spot" he found, and Calvin: "That sounds great, Dave! Can't wait to see it." [S30T17][S30T18]; Dave then shared it — "Check it out, Calvin. It's really calming, I think you'll like it." — and the two agreed "We will definitely go there!" (a plan to visit the spot together; if it is the same Japanese-garden scene Calvin photographed, the two have found a shared favorite, though Calvin's photo is the only image attached to it so far) [S30T19].
- On 2023-10-29, told Calvin he's been getting into photography recently — he's "seen some amazing places and taken some great shots" — and offered to show Calvin them (Calvin: "Yeah, show me what you got!") [S27T2][S27T3].
- Shared two Boston photos with Calvin on 2023-10-29: first, a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a clock tower — "Look at this magnificent sunset I captured on camera. It's truly breathtaking to witness such beautiful sunsets! The sky looks like it's on fire!" (Calvin: "Wow, that view looks awesome!") [S27T4][S27T5]; second, a photo of the clock tower in the city with buildings around it, which he took last month (~September 2023) — "got a great shot - it was stunning!" (Calvin: "Wow, that pic is amazing!") [S27T6].
- When Calvin recognized the clock tower ("In your last photo, is that the clock tower?"), Dave confirmed it is the clock tower — he snapped it at sunset and the colors were stunning [S27T7][S27T8].
- On 2023-10-29, said photography helps him capture and appreciate the beauty of nature — "It's been an awesome creative outlet and I'm loving it." (his appreciation of nature echoes his park walks — see ## Parks; Calvin: "You're so talented, Dave!", to which Dave said "Thanks, Calvin! Your kind words mean a lot.") (Calvin's side in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S27T8].
- On 2023-10-25, when Calvin told him he'd enjoyed sightseeing in Boston the day before (2023-10-24), said Boston has "so much to do" and mentioned one of his favorites there that is "great for chilling and admiring nature" (consistent with his Boston-parks remarks, see above and ## Parks); Calvin: "I followed your advice and went there, it was so peaceful." [S26T2][S26T3].
